findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_editor_inspect_project, picorn_blueprint_compile, picorn_media_list, picorn_files_list, picorn_posts_list · Private data: picorn_projects_create, picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_projects_update, picorn_generate_vector_assets, picorn_editor_import_image, picorn_editor_create_slideshow, picorn_search_library, picorn_blueprint_compile, picorn_blueprint_create_file, picorn_account_status, picorn_social_accounts_connect, picorn_campaigns_create, picorn_campaigns_list, picorn_campaigns_inspect, picorn_media_list, picorn_files_list, picorn_posts_schedule, picorn_posts_list, picorn_posts_cancel · Public sink: picorn_edit_image, picorn_editor_import_image, picorn_blueprint_examples, picorn_posts_upload_video, picorn_campaigns_create, picorn_media_list, picorn_files_list, picorn_posts_schedule, picorn_posts_cancel · Destructive: picorn_generate_vector_assets, picorn_edit_image, picorn_editor_delete_slide, picorn_editor_delete_layers, picorn_editor_ungroup_layers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_editor_inspect_project, picorn_blueprint_compile, picorn_media_list, picorn_files_list, picorn_posts_list · Private data: picorn_projects_create, picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_projects_update, picorn_generate_vector_assets, picorn_editor_import_image, picorn_editor_create_slideshow, picorn_search_library, picorn_blueprint_compile, picorn_blueprint_create_file, picorn_account_status, picorn_social_accounts_connect, picorn_campaigns_create, picorn_campaigns_list, picorn_campaigns_inspect, picorn_media_list, picorn_files_list, picorn_posts_schedule, picorn_posts_list, picorn_posts_cancel · Public sink: picorn_edit_image, picorn_editor_import_image, picorn_blueprint_examples, picorn_posts_upload_video, picorn_campaigns_create, picorn_media_list, picorn_files_list, picorn_posts_schedule, picorn_posts_cancel · Destructive: picorn_generate_vector_assets, picorn_edit_image, picorn_editor_delete_slide, picorn_editor_delete_layers, picorn_editor_ungroup_layers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
